name: Outflank [Teamwork]
body:
You look for every edge when flanking an enemy.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are flanking the same creature, your ally’s flanking bonus on attack rolls increases to +4. In addition, whenever you score a critical hit against the flanked creature, it provokes an attack of opportunity from your ally.
